title: SpecKit
tagline: Iteration discipline I layered on top of the spec-kit framework
tagline_zh: 在开源 spec-kit 框架之上沉淀的迭代纪律
summary: Notes on running spec-kit projects without losing the spec-plan-tasks-tests thread, plus the rules I use to stop LLMs from compressing the red-green loop.
summary_zh: 如何在 spec-kit 工作流中保住 spec、plan、tasks、tests 的对齐，加上我用来防止 LLM 压缩红绿循环的几条硬规则。

tagline_zh: 公司级情绪打分加按需 RAG，从本地 Next.js 原型移植到浏览器版

title: Vigil
tagline: Orchestrator that watches every Claude Code session
tagline_zh: 盯着所有 Claude Code 会话的总指挥
summary: A localhost web server that tails JSONL logs across all my Claude Code sessions, runs scheduled patrols, dispatches self-inspections to idle panes, and writes activity digests so I can context-switch without losing state.
summary_zh: 在 localhost 跑的 web server，监控所有 Claude Code 会话的 JSONL 日志，做定时巡检、给闲置 pane 派自检任务，把进展写成简报，让我切换项目时不丢上下文。
